name: Dedicated Grant Mechanism for Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (DGM)
summary: A mechanism of the Climate Investment Funds that channels grants to grassroots Indigenous Peoples and local community organisations for sustainable forest management, traditional livelihoods and land tenure, through country projects governed by Indigenous and community steering committees.

geography.label: Forest Investment Program countries with a DGM country project

applicant_types.quote: DGM country projects provide grants and technical support directly to grassroots organizations of Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities in target areas.

geography.quote: Beyond the global project, the DGM also supports 12 projects in countries of the Forest Investment Program (FIP).

access.quote: It approves sub-projects and appoints a qualified local organization to serve as the National Executing Agency to manage national DGM activities.
